summary_claims.claim: Art. 23 sets up class-and-grade management by public-opinion attributes, content category, user scale, data importance and degree of intervention in user behaviour
Arts. 18-21 protect minors, the elderly, workers and consumers
Art. 31 sets warnings, suspension of updates and fines of 10,000 to 100,000 yuan

note: Searched for a 2026 amendment of the Algorithmic Recommendation Provisions: nothing found; a law-firm review of April 2026 still treats it as current. All quotes matched the stored texts; the fields checked say what the record states.
